title: A third of playtest tool calls are action discovery, not play
body:
Action ids are not derivable from room prose, so a player must call
`list_legal_actions` before nearly every step. One playtest lead measured roughly a
third of its total tool calls as discovery overhead rather than play.

That ratio is the whole argument for fixing it. The playtest loop's design premise is
cheap models in mass parallel; at a third of calls spent asking "what can I even type
here", a third of the fleet's token budget buys no coverage. It also compounds with
model quality in the wrong direction — the cheaper the model, the larger the share of
its context spent on menu retrieval instead of judgement, which is precisely the segment
the volume tier exists to sample.

Reported independently as friction by more than one lead in the same run:

  Lead A: "Action ids aren't derivable from room prose, so `list_legal_actions` is
           mandatory before nearly every step — roughly a third of my calls were
           discovery overhead rather than play."
  Lead C: prose says "DON padded byre-jerkin" while the only action is
           `take_byre_jerkin`; following the text produces a flat rejection.

Lead C's example is the mechanism behind lead A's number: the narration names actions in
a vocabulary the action surface does not accept, so reading carefully actively misleads,
and the only reliable move is to enumerate.

Directions worth weighing (design call, not a prescription):

  - Have room observations carry their own action ids inline, so the prose a player just
    read is sufficient to act on and the enumerate-first reflex disappears.
  - Or accept a small vocabulary of verbs against named nouns ("take jerkin") and resolve
    to ids server-side, so following the narration works.
  - Or, cheapest: make the rejection message for a near-miss name the correct id, turning
    one wasted call into a correction rather than a lookup.

Measurement to keep honest afterwards: the share of tool calls in a session that are
`list_legal_actions` or `get_observation` versus state-advancing actions. It is
computable directly from stored transcripts, so the improvement is checkable against the
existing corpus rather than by impression.

evidence.summary: Measured by one lead at ~1/3 of calls; a second lead found prose naming verbs the action surface rejects.
